dataset.wall_clock_note: first_to_last_finish_min is the elapsed time of each generation phase on a shared machine (10 worker processes, other jobs running)

summary.note_band: single_split_band_95_theory adds the calibration-draw variance (coverage given the calibration set is Beta distributed, variance about a(1-a)/(n_cal+2)) to the binomial test variance.
summary.note: Each output's 95% Clopper-Pearson CI covers only the test-set binomial error. It ignores the calibration draw (q-hat is itself random), and every output shares the same calibration and test points, so these per-output checks are neither complete nor independent. The theory band and the re-split check below account for both sources. Above-nominal coverage on outputs with many ties (miss rates that are exactly 0) is expected: split conformal guarantees >= nominal.

resplit.note: score s <= q-hat is the same event as y inside the interval (before float rounding).

speed.note: Full-sim time is one design point at 2.0 simulated seconds (1.0 s burn-in plus a 1.0 s measured window) on the interactive mix, measured as process CPU time inside dataset generation on a shared machine. Surrogate time covers every output plus its conformal interval.

fidelity_check.note: Coverage against a different fidelity mix is not guaranteed; this measures the shift.

cosim_shift.note: Co-sim runs differ from the chip-only training runs (20 s runs, scenario events mid-run, robot-driven T5 releases, live core build). Coverage is not guaranteed here.

T7_control.miss_rate.degenerate: constant in the data; excluded from coverage statistics

guarantee: Split conformal and CQR give marginal coverage >= 1 - alpha under exchangeability of calibration and test design points. They do not give coverage conditional on a design, and they say nothing outside the sampled design space or under a changed simulator.
